strategy.thesis: SAP's strategic business unit to incubate, accelerate and scale startup innovation; the SAP.iO Fund makes early-stage equity investments in B2B software startups that extend the SAP ecosystem.

summary.en: SAP.iO is SAP's open-innovation unit combining the SAP.iO Fund (a $35M early-stage venture fund launched in 2017) with the SAP.iO Foundry accelerator network. It makes equity investments of more than $250K in B2B software startups that expand the SAP ecosystem, and reports its broader portfolio has yielded 5 unicorns and 70 exits.
